issue.title: [Enhancement]: Allow to override PULL_RETRY_TIME_LIMIT

repository.name: testcontainers-java
repository.description: Testcontainers is a Java library that supports JUnit tests, providing lightweight, throwaway instances of common databases, Selenium web browsers, or anything else that can run in a Docker container.

issue.body:
### Module

Core

### Proposal

RemoteDockerImage set value on PULL_RETRY_TIME_LIMIT to 2 minutes max

Is it possible to override this duration directly on a specific container by setting an env variable 
PULL_RETRY_TIME_LIMIT_MINUTES = 3

body: I want to take this issue, can you please assign this to me?

issue.title: Introduce new property to configure pull.timeout

repository.name: testcontainers-java
repository.description: Testcontainers is a Java library that supports JUnit tests, providing lightweight, throwaway instances of common databases, Selenium web browsers, or anything else that can run in a Docker container.

issue.body:
Currently, the pull timeout is set to 2 minutes. This commit introduces
a new property `pull.timeout` to be configured in seconds.

Fixes #9191
